description: Soil Type.tif code -> soil-map name the v2-9 model's `type` StringLookup was adapted on. Copied from mlprep/datasets/nc_mapped.mapping.json (metadata.type_recode); agrees with combined_mapped (Makilala training) on every shared code.
source_note: majority SU_19_v1_contri.gpkg `type` at slope-unit representative points sampled on Soil Type.tif. Low purity (<80%): 458 (77%), 453 (78%), 305 (75%), 94 (70%). 999 and 1 had ~no slope units (likely water/built-up) and were set to Undifferentiated by assumption. 435 had no representative points; set to Clay from 153 grid cells inside SU_19 units (90% Clay, 10% Silty Clay Loam) — weak evidence, lowland Pigkawayan.
